The '''Prine system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Vilonis sector/Legends|Vilonis sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] that contained<ref name="EAOC" /> the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Prine]] and its [[Moon/Legends|moons]].<ref name="OOTW 1" />
